title: glitch-port event (protocol v1)
description: A single error or message event accepted by POST /api/{projectId}/events. Field names are snake_case. The Relay supplies omitted defaults, truncates strings longer than the limits below, drops entries beyond the count limits, and ignores unknown top-level properties. The whole request body is limited to 1 MB; contexts and extra are limited to 65536 bytes (64 KB) serialized each and are omitted when larger, while the event is still accepted.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier: 32 hexadecimal characters or a UUID string. The Relay generates an identifier when the field is omitted.

timestamp.description: Time at which the event occurred as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date-time with a timezone. The Relay uses the receive time when the field is omitted.

level.description: Event severity. The Relay defaults to error when an exception is present and info otherwise.

platform.description: Platform or runtime that sent the event (unity, unreal, godot, dotnet, javascript). Required.

logger.description: Logger or subsystem that produced the event, for example UnityEngine.Debug.

message.description: Human-readable event message. At least one of message or exception is required.

environment.description: Deployment environment, for example production, staging or development.

server_name.description: Host name or server that produced the event.

sdk.description: Name and version of the client SDK that produced the event.

name.description: SDK package name, for example glitchport.unity.

exception.description: Exceptions ordered from the innermost cause (index 0) to the outermost observed exception (last item). The Relay keeps the first 10 entries when more are sent.

type.description: Exception type. Required and must not be blank.

module.description: Assembly, module or namespace that defines the exception.

stacktrace.description: Stack trace captured for this exception.

frames.description: Stack frames ordered from the deepest call (index 0) to the shallowest; the last frame is the crash site. The Relay keeps the last 250 frames when more are sent.

module.description: Module, assembly or namespace that contains the frame.

filename.description: Source file name as reported by the runtime.

abs_path.description: Absolute path of the source file, when available.

context_line.description: Source line at lineno, when available.

in_app.description: True when the frame belongs to the game's own code rather than engine or framework code.

tags.description: String key/value tags used for filtering and grouping. The Relay keeps the first 50 entries.

user.description: Information about the user affected by the event.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the user, or the literal {{auto}} so the Relay can substitute the address of the request.

contexts.description: Free-form context namespaces such as os, runtime, device, gpu or game. The Relay enforces a maximum serialized size of 65536 bytes (64 KB) and omits contexts that exceed the limit; the event is still accepted.

breadcrumbs.description: Breadcrumbs in chronological order (oldest first). The Relay keeps the first 100 entries when more are sent.

timestamp.description: Time at which the breadcrumb was recorded.

category.description: Breadcrumb category, for example scene, input or http.

type.description: Breadcrumb type, for example default or http.

data.description: Free-form JSON data attached to the breadcrumb.

fingerprint.description: Custom grouping key. When present, the Processor groups the event by these strings instead of computing a fingerprint from the exception or message. The Relay keeps the first 10 entries.

extra.description: Free-form extra data. The Relay enforces a maximum serialized size of 65536 bytes (64 KB) and omits extra data that exceeds the limit; the event is still accepted.
